title: Townhouse at Polo Villas
description: A three-storey townhouse in Polo Villas Parklane with a new modern renovation — for $250,000. Just 4 minutes from the sea, one of the best low-rise communities in Batumi. Location: the club community is within the city, in the Adlia district. Metro City mall — 6 minutes by car, all essential city infrastructure — 8–10 minutes by car, the airport — 3 minutes by car. 5 minutes away is the Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park, the promenade and the sea. The park has plenty of greenery, evergreen plants, skate and bike zones, and outdoor fitness equipment. About the property: 118.4 m² — 3 bedrooms, a kitchen-living room, two bathrooms, a comfortable terrace and a private green yard. A new renovation has been done using premium-segment materials, with underfloor heating and soundproofing in the walls. All furniture and appliances stay. About the community: Polo Villas Parklane is one of the most popular suburban communities in Batumi. The territory is gated with 24/7 security and large landscaped grounds. There is a fitness area, coworking, sauna and jacuzzi. A pool, sun loungers and various lounge areas, table tennis, children's and sports playgrounds. There is a supermarket and a wine cellar on site. Each townhouse has its own parking. Price: $250,000. Available with a mortgage. Eligible for a residence permit.
address: Batumi, Adlia district, Polo Villas Parklane
